description: The mobile TOC drawer honors edge, vertical, scroll, editable, modal, multitouch, and cancel guards. The phone's screen is 393x851. The page has synthetic touch gestures, run with eval: "window.__drawerSwipe(selector, x1, y1, x2, y2)" puts one finger down at viewport point x1,y1 on the first element matching selector, moves it to x2,y2 and lifts it; "window.__drawerDrag(selector, points, ending, secondFinger, modalAtEnd)" puts a finger down at the first [x, y] of points and moves it through the rest (with a second finger beside it when secondFinger is true), then ends with ending ("touchend" or "touchcancel"); when modalAtEnd is true a modal (".command-palette-overlay" with aria-modal) appears just before the release and goes after it. __drawerDrag returns the computed styles ({className, transform, translate, opacity}) of every ".drawer, .backdrop, .toc-drawer, .toc-drawer-scrim" element just before the release, and keeps them in window.__drawerDragStyles. Run each gesture with a single eval, without expect; wait for its target to exist first. "Open" means the drawer (".drawer") has the class "open"; "closed" that it does not. A conversation exists at /c/{{SLUG}}. "The TOC drawer" is ".toc-drawer". "Open the TOC" means drag ".main-content" through [[220,300],[130,302],[40,304]] with "touchend", then the TOC drawer should be visible; "close the TOC" means drag ".toc-drawer" through [[100,300],[200,302],[300,304]] with "touchend", then the TOC drawer should be hidden. Eval "window.__drawerAddFields()" adds to the main content an input, a textarea, a status hook (".status-hook-item"), a contenteditable, and horizontally scrollable regions (".horizontal-test > div"), code (".code-scroll code") and table (".table-scroll td"). Eval "window.__drawerSwipePatchDiff(220, 160)" adds a horizontally scrollable patch diff to the main content and swipes one of its lines from x 220 to x 160. Perform the numbered steps in order, each fully. A button "X" is the element with role button (a <button>) whose accessible name (aria-label, else its text) is exactly X; "There is no S", "no S" or "none" means no element matches at all: assert_count 0, never a visibility check. Whether an element "has the class X" is an eval of its classList.contains('X') (polled with expect), never a visibility check: a collapsed drawer may have no size. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. ".toc-button" should be visible. 3. Swipe ".main-content" from 220,300 to 180,304. 4. The TOC drawer should be visible. 5. Swipe ".toc-drawer" from 100,300 to 300,304. 6. The TOC drawer should be hidden. 7. Swipe ".main-content" from 40,300 to 16,304. 8. The TOC drawer should be visible. 9. Swipe ".toc-drawer" from 100,300 to 300,304. 10. The TOC drawer should be hidden. 11. Swipe ".main-content" from 28,300 to 4,304. 12. The TOC drawer is hidden. 13. Swipe ".main-content" from 350,300 to 288,304. 14. The TOC drawer should be visible. 15. Swipe ".toc-drawer" from 100,300 to 300,304. 16. The TOC drawer should be hidden. 17. Swipe ".main-content" from 382,300 to 320,304 (the right system edge), then swipe ".main-content" from 180,200 to 184,280 (vertical). 18. The TOC drawer is hidden. 19. Eval "window.__drawerAddFields()". 20. For each of the selectors "input", "textarea", ".status-hook-item", "[contenteditable=\"true\"]", ".horizontal-test > div", ".code-scroll code" and ".table-scroll td", in turn: swipe the first element it matches from 220,300 to 180,304, then check that the TOC drawer is hidden. 21. Eval "window.__drawerSwipePatchDiff(220, 160)". 22. The TOC drawer is hidden. 23. Eval "(() => { const modal = document.createElement('div'); modal.className = 'command-palette-overlay'; modal.setAttribute('aria-modal', 'true'); document.querySelector('.main-content').append(modal); return 'modal'; })()". 24. Swipe ".main-content" from 220,300 to 180,304. 25. The TOC drawer is hidden. 26. Eval "document.querySelector('.command-palette-overlay').remove()". 27. Drag ".main-content" through [[220,300],[130,302],[40,304]] ending with "touchcancel". 28. The TOC drawer is hidden. 29. Drag ".main-content" through [[220,300],[130,302],[40,304]] with "touchend", no second finger, and a modal at the end. 30. The TOC drawer is hidden. 31. Open the TOC. 32. Drag ".toc-drawer" through [[100,300],[200,302],[300,304]] with "touchend", no second finger, and a modal at the end. 33. The TOC drawer is visible, and its style attribute, if any, does not contain "translate". 34. Drag ".toc-drawer" through [[100,300],[200,302],[300,304]] with "touchend" and a second finger. 35. The TOC drawer is visible. 36. Drag ".toc-drawer" through [[100,300],[200,302],[300,304]] ending with "touchcancel". 37. The TOC drawer is visible. 38. Close the TOC.

steps.expression: (() => { const modal = document.createElement('div'); modal.className = 'command-palette-overlay'; modal.setAttribute('aria-modal', 'true'); document.querySelector('.main-content').append(modal); return 'modal'; })()

(function(){ const el = document.querySelector('.toc-drawer'); if (!el) return 'no-element'; const style = el.getAttribute('style') || ''; return style.includes('translate') ? 'has-translate' : 'no-translate'; })()
